anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

pass_a_gloss: So that the mind lying in the things that happened concerning the history may be shown more completely by speech, we shall come upon the very sayings according to the word.
pass_b_english: So that the mind that lies in the events of the history may be shown more completely in speech, we shall come to the very words, according to the letter.
source_text: [Ἴ]να δὲ λό[γῳ ἐν]τε[λ]έστερον ὁ [ν]οῦς ὁ ἐγ[κε]ίμενο[ς] περὶ τὰ γενόμε[να] περὶ τῆς ἱστορίας δειχθῇ, [ἐπ’ αὐ]τὰ τὰ ῥητὰ κατὰ λέξιν ἐ[λε]υσ[ό]μεθα.
